notes: r61 restores fast locked-channel opening while preserving r60/r59/r57 safety fixes. MANUAL_LOCK TS streams are asynchronously pre-warmed during the unchanged OpenATV PAT/PMT safety window, native locked playback uses a low-latency relay startup profile, read chunk is reduced to 128 KiB for faster first data, and failed native locked playback rescues around 1.15 s (1.45 s UHD) instead of waiting the r46 3.0/4.2 s FHD/UHD ceilings. Automatic/unlocked channels keep the stable r46 ceilings. Target is about 1-2 s for healthy locked channels on responsive providers; remote server/network latency can still exceed this.
